text: U.S. stock markets were mixed on Wednesday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average rising to record highs while the Nasdaq Composite declined as investors weighed strong corporate earnings against concerns over high artificial intelligence (AI) capital expenditures. Market breadth showed divergence, with healthcare and technology stocks seeing gains—led by companies like Eli Lilly following upbeat guidance—while industrials, energy, and utility sectors lagged amid ongoing geopolitical uncertainty regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Volatility remained a factor as investors reacted to earnings reports from major firms like SpaceX and Advanced Micro Devices, whose shares fell due to concerns over heavy AI-related spending despite revenue beats.
